CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [graph].[GetPathSegment] ( @id bigint ) RETURNS nvarchar(2500) AS BEGIN DECLARE @text nvarchar(2500)
select @text = coalesce(string_agg(O.Segment, '.'),'[ERROR:KEY_FIELDS_NULL]') from ( select top 100 '['+coalesce(FormattedValue,'')+']' as Segment from Field F inner join FieldType T on T.ID = F.FieldTypeID and T.IsPartOfKey = 1 and F.AssetID = @id order by T.ColumnOrder ) O
RETURN @text END
